meaning:
ἱερατεύω
(cl. = ἱεράομαι) [in LXX chiefly for כָּהַן pi. ;]
to be a priest, officiate as a priest: Luk.1:8 (the word is frequently in Inscr.; see LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 215; LAE, 70; Cremer, 734).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division
